bugs.description: Converting the validated external identifier to a number strips leading zeros, so distinct identifiers such as 00123 and 123 collapse to the same map key.
bugs.reachablePreconditions: The upstream identifier namespace treats fixed-width digit strings with different leading zeros as distinct customer identifiers.
bugs.observableImpact: Indexing overwrites one customer record with another, and subsequent lookups can return the wrong customer.
bugs.provenance: Seeded from a base implementation that validated and returned the trimmed string unchanged. Confirmed by curator-only executable proof.
